sourceObservation.putToFiler: The final metadata CreateEntry intentionally uses context.Background, independently of an HTTP request cancellation. Bucket policy is checked before reading the body; cancellation, signature expiry and a momentary HEAD404 do not establish settled upload.
sourceObservation.existingCopBehavior: withOwnedMediaWrite persists a lease before the actual PUT and clears it only after acknowledged completion; unknown outcomes remain pending. External presigned PUT bypasses this API lease.
sourceObservation.missingProductionOwner: MediaUploadSettlementVerifier is required by verifiedErasureReady; createMediaStorageFromEnv currently receives none in production.

fixtureDecision.reason: Do not start a second provider on the small production storage host. This is source analysis plus actual version/config metadata, not a reproduced live race.

remainingImplementation: Gate every potentially admitted COP object write at a provider boundary, including legacy presigned requests. The erasure fence must wait for the actual provider commit/drain before DELETE and final readback.
Preserve existing API and native upload compatibility; signature expiration is not a substitute.
Use an isolated exact-version provider fixture on a host with adequate memory to exercise delayed body/final commit, erase-vs-upload, crash, retry, restore and second-account preservation.
Any change or restart of the shared S3 provider requires a concrete coordinated deployment plan; no shared service was modified by this inspection.
